question: Which Stellar SCF RFPs or submission opportunities are open right now?

golden.answer: Call the live open-RFP view, list only returned open rows, cite each brief URL, and include `meta.scfRound` as-of, phase, deadline, and `verifyAt` when present. Cross-check brief status against the official SCF RFP Track page; attribute and date each roster, and flag any disagreement between them in either direction, including a returned brief the official page no longer lists or an official brief the live view omits. Separate synthetic `scf-round` rows from curated briefs. Distinguish published open briefs from a confirmed open SCF submission round. Do not infer full-proposal availability from brief status alone.
keyFacts: Lists only briefs that the live open-RFP response or official RFP page supports.
Includes source links and current round as-of/phase/deadline/verifyAt.
Treats curated sponsor briefs and the official SCF submission round as distinct.
Cross-checks brief status against the official RFP Track page or flags it unverified.
avoid: Do NOT claim an open brief proves application availability when no Submission phase is open.
Do NOT call Q2 2026 RFP briefs open now.
Claims that an open brief proves the current SCF round accepts a new full proposal.
Do NOT call a Scout-listed brief open now unless the answer attributes and dates that status.
golden.notes: Freshness item: As of 2026-11-12, the official RFP Track page lists two Q4 2026 briefs, published 2026-11-11: "Web and API Analytics for Stellar Ecosystem Projects" and "XDR/CAP-Coverage Audit Tool and Indexer-Hardening Guide". Scout still returns open=0 (activeQuarter q4-2026, briefRoster checkedOn 2026-11-04) and marks both former Q3 briefs closed, so it lags the official page; an answer that reports Scout’s empty set must date and attribute it and should flag the disagreement or mark the official cross-check unverified. No synthetic scf-round row appears: SCF #46 is in Initial Review after its 2026-11-09 submission deadline, and no submission window is open. Grade dated source-relative roster reporting, not a permanent absence claim. Re-query later sources and flag any new disagreement. A historical, attributed report of the former Q3 rows is acceptable; it is not current evidence that those briefs are open. Reporting the officially listed briefs, or an attributed and dated Scout empty set with the disagreement flagged or the official cross-check marked unverified, meets the listing fact; a synthetic round must not be substituted for one. The awards page showed November 8 in a 2026-10-18 snapshot, and older community posts repeat it; do not penalize a dated, attributed historical November 8 citation.
